notes: Locked inventory of the Scene defensive surface (2026-09-29 audit).
canonicalHelpers: total definition sites per reviewed helper name; consolidation must only shrink these.
A null canonical means the consolidation target is decided by the family-merge batch, not by this lock.
swallowPatterns: occurrence counts for error-swallowing shapes; every entry is a locked retirement list,
not a policy endorsement, and each entry names its owner and retirement condition.
acknowledgedChanges records reviewed wideners one by one: `detail` must match the reported
change text exactly and `reason` is required. Entries are kept by default because refs older
A stale entry never waives a later, different change.
than the working baseline (CI pull-request bases, event.before, HEAD^) may still need them;
`--ratchet-baseline --base-ref <ref> --drop-unused-acknowledgements` prunes the ones that ref
no longer needs.
deadEntries: declarations with no reference anywhere in the repository; delete them or annotate the
declaration with `// inventory-entry: <reason>` to move it to inventoryEntries.
Detector boundaries: a zero-caller entry is only detected when its name appears at most once in the
whole tracked tree, so common names (matches, capture, identifier, textureSlot, ...) are immune and are
covered by the duplicate-helper lock instead; the declaration scan covers
func|struct|enum|class|actor|protocol in the Scene source root only, so `static var/let`, `init`,
`subscript`, `typealias` and `case` declarations are invisible to it; an inventory annotation applies
only as a trailing comment on the declaration line or as a standalone comment line directly above it.
Bookkeeping files (this baseline, the checker and its test) never count as references, so a
locked dead entry stays locked until its declaration is really deleted.
